senses.gloss: f. (סָבַל; cmp. סִבְלוֹנוֹת) sending provisions for a common meal, picnic.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 89b:7">Pes. 89ᵇ</cite> <he>אפי׳ חמשה ועשו ס׳</he> (Ms. O. repeatedly <he>סבלונות</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 7) even (in ordinary cases) when five persons sent articles of food for a picnic; <cite ref="Tosefta Pesachim 7:10">Tosef. ib. VII, 10</cite> (Var. <cite ref="O00041"><he>סבול</he></cite>, <he>סיבלות</he>); Y. ib. VIII, 36ᵃ <cite ref="O00726"><he>סִינְבּוּל</he></cite> (with anorg. <cite ref="N00001"><he>נ</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maaser Sheni 4:6:3">Y. Maas. Sh. IV, 55ᵇ</cite> <he>אני אומר סיבולית וכ׳</he> I say (the inscriptions ‘in behalf of—’ intimate) that they have arranged a picnic among themselves (and each marked his contribution).
